Get the Boundaries of Municipalities, Districts and Cantons

Source: R/geo-gemeinde.R
geo-boundaries.Rd

Returns the polygons of the Swiss political municipalities, districts or cantons for a defined stand, ready to be joined with statistics of the same stand and drawn with plotMap().

Usage

geoGemeinde(
  date = NULL,
  source = c("themakart", "swissboundaries3d"),
  crs = NULL,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  ...
)

geoBezirk(date = NULL, crs = NULL, cache = TRUE, refresh = FALSE, ...)

geoKanton(date = NULL, crs = NULL, cache = TRUE, refresh = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

date

stand of the boundaries, a Date or a string "YYYY-MM-DD". The default NULL uses the most recent stand.

source

source of the municipal boundaries, "themakart" or "swissboundaries3d".

crs

optional target CRS, an EPSG code or anything accepted by sf::st_crs(); NULL keeps EPSG:2056.

cache

logical; if TRUE, results are read from and written to the local cache (see cacheList()).

refresh

logical; if TRUE, the source is queried again even if a cached copy exists.

...

further arguments passed to geoThemakart(), e.g. area = "vegetation" or setYear.

Value

An sf object with stand_d, the unit's id and name (gem_id/gem_x, bezirk_id/bezirk_x, or kanton_id/kanton_x and kanton_c) and geometry. The key is stand_d + id.

Details

Two sources are available for municipalities:

"themakart"

the generalised BFS geometries for thematic maps (see geoThemakart()): small, fast and the official basis of statistical maps; total area including lakes.

"swissboundaries3d"

swisstopo's full-resolution boundaries, obtained through the STAC API of data.geo.admin.ch, for precise spatial analysis. The release valid at date is used. Communal condominia and lake areas are excluded, Z coordinates dropped, parts combined to one MULTIPOLYGON per municipality, and invalid geometries repaired with sf::st_make_valid() and reported (attributes repairedGemId, emptyGemId). The first download is large.

Districts and cantons always come from ThemaKart. Geometries are in LV95 (EPSG:2056); another CRS is only used if crs is given.

See also

gemeinde(), plotMap().

Other swiss.geometry: geoGewaesser(), geoThemakart(), themakartSets()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
geo <- geoGemeinde(as.Date("2021-01-01"))
plotMap(geo)
kt <- geoKanton()
} # }
